casino.interrupted_body: In the event of disconnection, a previously started round that has been interrupted may be resumed immediately by starting the game again. The results of a completed round (where display of the visual result was interrupted) will only be re-displayed within the game for winning rounds, but all game rounds may be reviewed in History. Any amount wagered on an unfinished game will remain paused until you either complete the game or the game is void as a result of account inactivity or system maintenance. When an unfinished game is void, your bet will be refunded to your account. Any awards earned on an unfinished round will not be credited unless you resume and complete the game. Winnings on unfinished game rounds where the player cannot further influence the outcome of the game will be automatically credited to the player's account after [[:period]]. Game rounds that require additional player input to determine the outcome of the game will remain unfinished for [[:period]], after which a default choice will automatically be made in order to complete the round and credit any winnings to the player's account. Game rounds will never be affected by unforeseen external errors due to hardware, bandwidth, network errors or similar. Game rounds will be either stored and completed by the player at a later time or they will be closed and the wager will be refunded to the player. If an incomplete game round has not been resumed within [[:rollbackAfter]], the round will be rolled back and the wager will be refunded.

casino.jackpot_body:
All Max Wins will be manually reviewed to ensure compliance with Hacksaw Gaming's terms and conditions as well as the terms and conditions of the operator. Any evidence of abuse or collusion will result in a loss of any Max Wins. All decisions are final.
After any Max Win Hacksaw Gaming reserves the right to request proof of age and perform checks in order to verify the identity and information provided by the account holder. These rules apply for the account holder:
- must not be under 18 years of age;
- must provide proof of address;
- must be a physical person (a legal entity will not be accepted);
- must not to be acting on behalf of another party;
- must not to be restricted by limited legal capacity.

The Max Win can not be won when playing in demo mode. Max Win winners will be contacted within 48 hours to verify the win.
casino.jackpot_won: Congratulations! You will be contacted within 48 hours to verify the win. All Max Win winnings will be manually reviewed to ensure compliance with current terms and conditions.

casino.win_body: Winnings and winning combinations are paid according to the paytable. Multiple wins in one round are added together and the total round win will be displayed in the WIN field (to the right of BALANCE). Separate wins in a winning combination will be displayed during the win presentation. Symbol payouts are displayed in the paytable and reflect the current bet configuration. Only the highest win per winning way is paid. Some win amounts may be displayed in an abbreviated format using letters to represent large numbers. When a win amount is displayed in this format, the displayed value may be rounded down. The actual amount awarded will never be less than the displayed value.

casino.about_the_game_desc_4: The bags are packed and it’s time to venture into the heart of the wilderness, where preparation is everything! Stalk your way through the vast savannas of [[Great Game Serengeti]], a 5-reel, 3-row game featuring paylines and a max win of [[:maximumWinMultiplier]] times your bet available in every game mode!
casino.hunting_season_desc_1: When a [[Hunting Season]] symbol lands on the grid, a Hunt is triggered after all regular wins have been handled. One target is located above each reel. Five shots are fired from left to right that will either hit or miss the target.
casino.hunting_season_desc_2: Any Animal symbols on the reels that are hit are transformed into Coin or Trap symbols. Animal symbols display between 1 and 4 stars, which determines the minimum currency revealed.
casino.hunting_season_desc_3: 1 Star Animal symbols grant a minimum of Bronze Coins.
casino.hunting_season_desc_4: 2 Star Animal symbols grant a minimum of Silver Coins
casino.hunting_season_desc_5: 3 Star Animal symbols grant a minimum of Gold Coins.
casino.hunting_season_desc_6: 4 Star Animal symbols transform into a Trap symbol with a minimum value equal to Gold Coins.
casino.hunting_season_desc_7: All Coins are awarded as a multiple of your bet.
casino.hunting_season_desc_8: Bronze Coins have the following starting values: [[0.2x, 0.4x, 0.6x, 0.8x, 1x]]
casino.hunting_season_desc_9: Silver Coins have the following starting values: [[2x, 3x, 4x, 5x]]
casino.hunting_season_desc_10: Gold Coins have the following starting values: [[10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x]]
casino.hunting_season_desc_11: Diamond Coins have the following starting values: [[100x, 150x, 250x, 500x]]
casino.hunting_season_desc_12: During a Hunt, when a 4 Star Animal symbol appears on a reel that is shot, that symbol will transform into a Trap symbol with a value. Trap symbols collect the values of all Coins and other Trap symbols and add the collected values to its existing Trap value. All collected symbols retain their original values when collected by a Trap symbol. Trap symbols activate top to bottom, left to right. The final win is the total value of all Coins and Trap symbols
casino.hunting_season_desc_13: If there is a [[Wild]] symbol on a reel that has been shot, that [[Wild]] symbol receives a Multiplier value. After all Coins and Trap symbols have been collected, each [[Wild]] symbol with a Multiplier multiplies between 1 and 5 Coin and Trap symbols. [[Wild]] symbols with Multipliers activate top to bottom, left to right. [[Wild]] symbols with Multipliers can have the following Multiplicative Multipliers: [[x2, x3, x4, x5, x10, x20]].
casino.hunting_season_desc_14: One [[Hunting Season]] symbol can appear on the grid at the same time.
casino.stampede_desc_1: During a spin, there is a chance that a [[Stampede]] Reveal will be triggered before any symbols have landed on the grid. When a [[Stampede]] Reveal is triggered, a [[Hunting Season]] symbol is guaranteed to land and no low-paying symbols can land on the grid. When the new symbols have landed, any wins and the Hunt will be handled before the next spin.
casino.bonus_game_khaki_quest_desc_1: Activate this bonus with 8 free spins by landing 3 [[FS]] [[scatter]] symbols at the same time during the base game.
casino.bonus_game_khaki_quest_desc_2: This bonus game keeps the base game’s mechanics, with a higher chance of landing [[Hunting Season]] symbols.
casino.bonus_game_roaring_reign_desc_1: Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 4 [[FS]] [[scatter]] symbols at the same time during the base game.
casino.bonus_game_roaring_reign_desc_2: This bonus game keeps the base game’s mechanics and [[Stampede]] Reveals will not trigger randomly. Instead, they are awarded through the Lion Bar, which is located outside of the grid
casino.bonus_game_roaring_reign_desc_3: For every low-paying symbol located on a reel that is hit during a Hunt, the Lion Bar increases by one step. When the Lion Bar has increased by 10 steps, a [[Stampede]] Reveal is guaranteed to be triggered during the following spin. When the [[Stampede]] Reveal has been triggered, the Lion Bar resets before the next free spin. Any Lion Bar progression exceeding the amount required to trigger a [[Stampede]] Reveal, will be added to the Lion Bar, once it has been reset.
casino.hidden_epic_bonus_game_zebrawl_desc_1: Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 5 [[FS]] [[scatter]] symbols at the same time during the base game.
casino.hidden_epic_bonus_game_zebrawl_desc_2: This bonus game keeps the mechanics of the [[ROARING REIGN]] bonus. In addition, a [[Hunting Season]] symbol is guaranteed to land on every spin.
casino.hidden_epic_bonus_game_zebrawl_desc_3: [[FS]] symbols cannot land in this bonus.

casino.maxwingermany_body: Maximum win: [[:maximumWinMultiplier]] times the total stake. Probability of getting the maximum win: 1:[[:oddsofmaxwin]]. The maximum win occurs when multiple Animal symbols land on each reel at the same time, with a Hunting Season symbol triggering a Hunt, which will transform each Animal symbol that is hit into Coin or Trap symbols, which will reveal a total combined cash prize value of [[:maximumWinMultiplier]] that is awarded as a multiple of the bet. The maximum win is the sum of all winning combinations when the reels are stationary, taking into account further winning opportunities such as bonus rounds and free spins. The maximum win can be achieved in the base game but is only possible with a lower probability, if bonus rounds are excluded.
